title: The Emptied Vault
summary: Forty boxes forced and empty; door, time lock and alarm untouched.
details: Forty safe-deposit boxes pried open with a flat bar. The vault door was closed and locked, the time lock set, the alarm armed. Discovered by Graham Pike at 09:05 Tuesday.

title: Loss Schedule
summary: £1.2 million in bearer bonds, jewellery and cash.
details: Bearer bonds £860,000, jewellery £290,000 (estimated), cash £50,000. Bond serial numbers circulated to every bank in the country.

title: Alarm Panel Printout
summary: Saturday: engineer's test at 16:00; at 23:08 the audit override code bypassed the vault sensor.
details:
16:00 engineer test mode (front keypad)
16:20 vault sensor tested
16:40 re-armed
23:08 rear keypad: override code 4-7 accepted, vault sensor bypassed
02:14 re-armed

Code 4-7 is issued to Head Office Audit and held by the senior auditor, E. Thorne.

title: Time-Lock Tape
summary: The time lock opened at 23:40 on Saturday by the manufacturer's service procedure.
details: The time lock's paper tape: 'SERVICE OVERRIDE 23:40 — OPEN'. The service procedure is in the manufacturer's manual, of which Head Office holds the only copy.

title: Staff-Entrance Log
summary: Doreen in at 07:00 Sunday. Pike in at 10:02 Sunday.
details:
Staff entrance, Easter weekend:

Sun 07:00  IN   D. Walsh   (out 09:05)
Sun 10:02  IN   G. Pike    (out 10:08)

title: Overtime Chit
summary: Pike paid Doreen £12 cash for an extra clean on Sunday morning.
details: 'D. Walsh, extra clean of manager's office, Sun 22 Apr, £12 cash. G.P.' Unofficial, and against branch rules, but innocent.

title: Guard's Patrol Book
summary: Pike was escorted in for his spectacles on Sunday. Six minutes.
details: Weekend guard: 'Sun 10:02 Mr Pike, escorted to his office to collect spectacles. Did not go below ground floor. Out 10:08.'

title: Parking Ticket on Kemp's Van
summary: Kemp's van ticketed on Harbour Street at 23:30 on Saturday.
details: Ridgeway Parking: Harbour Street, Saturday 21 April, 23:30. Offence: parked on the street-cleaning side after 23:00.

title: Kemp's Rent Book
summary: Kemp lives above his shop on Harbour Street. His van is always there.
details: Shop and living quarters above, 14 Harbour Street. The van is parked outside every night.

title: Rosa's Desk Calendar
summary: Saturday: the service call at four, a wedding at seven.
details: 'Service HS branch 4pm. Maria's wedding 7pm, Eastfield Hall!!' The bride's family confirm Rosa was there until one in the morning.

title: Service Ticket #881
summary: The Saturday alarm test, vault sensor included, was requested by Head Office Audit: E. Thorne.
details: Fortress Alarms ticket #881: 'Full sensor test incl. vault. Weekend please.' Requested Thursday 19 April, 16:50, by telephone from Head Office Audit, Mr E. Thorne.

title: Margaret Thorne's Account
summary: Thorne's sister: he went out at 20:30 on Saturday and came back at three.
details: By telephone: 'Edwin went out on Saturday about half past eight, to see a friend, he said. I heard his car come back at three. He was very quiet on Sunday.'

title: Millbrook Toll Receipt
summary: Thorne's Rover through the Millbrook toll at 21:40 Saturday, southbound to Ridgeway.
details: Toll receipt from the ashtray of Thorne's Rover: Millbrook plaza, Saturday 21:40, southbound. The toll authority's own record matches the registration.

title: Doreen's Note on the Vault Corridor
summary: On Sunday morning the vault corridor had already been mopped, and it smelled of bay rum.
details: Doreen Walsh: 'The corridor down to the vault was already wet when I got there. Someone had mopped it. And it smelled of bay rum, like a barber's. None of our staff wear that.'

title: Kemp's 1971 Conviction
summary: Walter Kemp: twelve years for safe-breaking.
details: Ridgeway Crown Court, 1971: Walter Kemp convicted of three safe-breakings. Released on licence 1983.

title: Audit Working Papers
summary: At Thursday's audit, Thorne opened both combination envelopes for seven minutes.
details: 'Combination envelopes A and B opened 15:02, contents verified, resealed 15:09. E.T.' For seven minutes one man held both halves of the combination.
